trap-nonspeakable.notes: ALL NUMERICS RE-DERIVED AND CORRECT (30 dps, proton pin; muon and old-muon pins agree to 7 digits, so this block does not discriminate the anchor). chi^{(2,1)}(sigma_1^n) = q^n + (-q^{-1})^n = q^n - q^{-n} for odd n: correct, and equals h [n]_q as stated. Seifert Euler numbers e = 1 - 1/2 - 1/n give e(T(2,3)) = 1/6 and e(T(2,5)) = 3/10, and V_S = 2 pi e reproduces pi/3 and 3 pi/5 exactly, so the ratio 9/5 is right (the block does not state the V_S = 2 pi e step, which is the one gap in an otherwise complete derivation). Combining: 1.091387013 x 3.24 = 3.536093922 vs PDG 3.537118439, i.e. -289.65 ppm (block: 290 ppm). THE POWER SCAN REPRODUCES TO SIX FIGURES: n_q = 1 gives -444,605 ppm and n_q = 3 gives +799,479 ppm, exactly the two numbers tabulated. Caveat on what the scan shows: with only three integer exponents tested and the neighbours off by 44% and 80%, the scan confirms n_q = 2 is the best integer but supplies no evidence about the two-body rationale, which the block correctly does not claim.
